observations: Photo 0 shows a black Canon DSLR camera with a lens attached, held in hand. The lens is labeled 'CANON ZOOM LENS EF-S 18-55mm 1:3.5-5.6 STM'. The camera body has 'Canon' and 'EOS Rebel T6i' visible on the top right.
Photo 1 shows the top of the camera with the lens, including the mode dial, ISO/DISP buttons, and a hot shoe. The camera appears to be in good physical condition with no visible cracks or dents.
Photo 2 shows the back of the camera with the LCD screen, viewfinder, and control buttons. The camera body is clean, and the lens is attached. No visible damage or wear is apparent.
All photos show a watermark 'MCSTEVE POSTED ON JIJI'.

claims.claim: Very Neat and Clean USA Used Canon EOS T6i/750D DSLR Camera still looking like a new one
claims.evidence: Photos show no visible damage, scratches, or wear. The camera and lens appear clean and well-maintained. The lens is labeled 'STM', which is consistent with the T6i model.
